definition: Number of goals scored by the team in the match. Penalty shootout kicks are not included.
calculation: Taken from the final match score for the team.
source: FBref FIFA World Cup 2026 Scores and Fixtures data

definition: Difference between the team's FIFA ranking points and the opponent's FIFA ranking points.
calculation: Team FIFA points - opponent FIFA points
source: FIFA Men's World Ranking released 11 June 2026

definition: Number of days since the team's previous senior international match.
calculation: Current match date - previous match date

definition: Height of the match stadium above sea level.
calculation: The stadium was matched with the venue altitude lookup table.
source: World Cup 2026 venue altitude data collected for the project

definition: Average goals scored by the team in its previous five senior international matches.
calculation: Goals scored in the previous five matches divided by 5

definition: Average goals conceded by the opponent in its previous five senior international matches.
calculation: Goals conceded by the opponent in the previous five matches divided by 5

definition: Shows whether the team's previous match went beyond the normal 90 minutes.
calculation: 1 if the previous match went to extra time, otherwise 0
source: Historical international results and World Cup match data

definition: Number of players in the current starting XI who did not start the team's previous match.
calculation: 11 - number of starters retained from the previous match
source: World Cup lineup data, Cornerflick and verified pre-tournament lineup sources
pre_match_available: Yes - after the starting XI is announced

definition: A simple measure used to represent greater qualification or elimination pressure.
calculation: 1 for the third group match or any knockout match, otherwise 0
source: Derived from the World Cup match stage and match order
